common.footerMotto: The night has its own rhythm.

home.heroDescription: Where smoke, music and neon create a world of their own. Leave everything else at the door.
home.marquee: HOOKAH ✦ COCKTAILS ✦ MUSIC ✦ PRIVATE ROOMS ✦ NIGHT VIBES ✦
home.aboutText1: Opium is a dark space with a bold character. Signature cocktails, thick smoke and music you feel in your body come together here.
home.aboutText2: We created a place without unnecessary pretension, but with attention to every detail.
home.perk1Text: Layered flavors, premium tobacco and masters who can read your mood.
home.perk2Text: DJ sets, hip-hop and R&B — the soundtrack to nights worth repeating.
home.perk3Text: VIP rooms with dedicated service for friends and private events.
home.vipText: Private rooms for up to 10 guests, dedicated service and complete privacy. Celebrate, work or simply go off the radar.
home.contactText: We're preparing a place for your next night out. We'll announce the address, opening hours and contact details before opening.
